# Q-050 E20: an edit in place of the two transactions of
# two_usd_arrivals_an_edit_goes_over.txt, the first with a new description and
# the second with a split stating the position of a line that states no `guid:`.
#
# Under `--strategy update` a position is the `guid:` the line it points at
# states, and this one states none, so which split of the book it is cannot be
# read from the file. That is found before any of the file is applied, so the
# first transaction keeps the description it had: an update applies the whole
# file or none of it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_split_draws_on_a_cost_basis_by_its_position_in_the_file.py.
